correction: The preflight's own diagnosis line in this run is wrong and has been fixed since. It read 'CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is not among the accounts this token can see', but listing accounts requires Account Settings Read, which a token scoped only to Workers AI correctly does not carry. Zero visible accounts is expected for a minimal token and is not evidence of a mismatch. The diagnosis now checks success first, so a working token is never reported as broken. The model results in this file were always correct; only the narrative line was not.
